================================================================================
1. ABOUT ILP STUDY
================================================================================
ILP Study is an authorized and specialized education consultancy in Bangladesh dedicated exclusively to facilitating admissions for Bangladeshi and South Asian students into top accredited higher education institutions across the People's Republic of China.

With on-the-ground liaison representatives in Harbin, China, and headquarters in Mirpur, Dhaka, ILP Study offers transparent, direct advisory without inflated intermediary fees. Services include:
- University course matching & academic eligibility evaluation
- Full and partial scholarship application guidance (CSC Type A & B, Provincial, University)
- CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) exam syllabus and preparation guidance
- Official Chinese Ministry of Education JW202 / JW201 student visa form processing
- Document notarization, translation, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) attestation support
- Pre-departure orientation, airport pickup coordination, and campus dorm registration

================================================================================
2. HARBIN PATHWAY PROGRAM (SPECIAL PROMOTION)
================================================================================
The Harbin Pathway Program is ILP Study's flagship accelerated route for Bangladeshi students:
- March Intake: Students begin with an intensive Chinese language program in Harbin.
- September Intake: Upon reaching eligibility, students qualify for up to 100% full degree scholarships for Bachelor's or Master's degrees.
- Eligible Fields: Computer Science & Software Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical & Aeronautical Engineering, International Economics & Trade, Artificial Intelligence.

================================================================================
3. DEGREE PROGRAMMES & TUITION ESTIMATES (RMB & BDT)
================================================================================
1. Bachelor's Degrees (English-taught):
   - Duration: 4 years
   - Average Tuition: 14,000 – 26,000 RMB/year (Approx. 235,000 – 435,000 BDT/year)
   - Popular Fields: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Civil Engineering, International Trade, Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering.
   - Admission Requirements: HSC / A-Levels completion with minimum GPA 3.50+ / C grades. Medium of Instruction (MOI) English certificate accepted in place of IELTS.

2. Master's & PhD Degrees (English or Chinese-taught):
   - Duration: 2 – 3 years (Master's) / 3 – 4 years (PhD)
   - Average Tuition: 18,000 – 32,000 RMB/year (Often 100% covered by scholarships)
   - Monthly Stipends on CSC: Master's: 3,000 RMB/month; PhD: 3,500 RMB/month.
   - Admission Requirements: Bachelor's degree (CGPA 3.00+), 2 Academic Recommendation Letters, Comprehensive Study Plan / Research Proposal (800+ words).

3. MBBS in China (English-taught):
   - Duration: 5 years classroom + 1 year hospital internship
   - Average Tuition: 28,000 – 45,000 RMB/year
   - Recognition: World Directory of Medical Schools (WDOMS), WHO, BMDC recognized institutions (e.g. Nanjing Medical University, Dalian Medical University, Southern Medical University, Wenzhou Medical University).

4. Chinese Language Programs (Non-degree):
   - Duration: 6 months (1 semester) or 1 year (2 semesters)
   - Focus: HSK 1 through HSK 5 preparation, spoken Mandarin, and cultural immersion.
   - Tuition: 6,000 – 14,000 RMB/year.

================================================================================
4. SCHOLARSHIP ROUTES IN CHINA
================================================================================
- Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type A): Administered through bilateral government agreements (Ministry of Education Bangladesh & Chinese Embassy Dhaka). Full tuition waiver, free accommodation, medical insurance, and living stipend (2,500 – 3,500 RMB/month).
- Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type B): Independent university recruitment route. Applied directly via designated Chinese university portals.
- Provincial Government Scholarships: Established by academic hub provinces (e.g., Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shandong, Heilongjiang) offering annual awards ranging from 10,000 to 30,000 RMB.
- University Institutional Scholarships: Direct full or partial tuition fee waivers awarded based on high school or undergraduate GPA.

================================================================================
5. CHINA STUDENT VISA (X1 & X2) ESSENTIAL CHECKLIST
================================================================================
- X1 Visa: For study periods exceeding 180 days (Degree and full-year language students). Converts to a Foreigner Residence Permit within 30 days of arrival in China.
- X2 Visa: For short-term study periods of 180 days or fewer.
- Required Documents:
  1. Valid Passport (minimum 12 months validity with blank visa pages)
  2. Original Admission Notice issued by the Chinese University
  3. Original JW202 or JW201 Visa Application Form issued by the Chinese Ministry of Education
  4. Foreigner Physical Examination Record completed by an authorized diagnostic hospital
  5. Police Clearance Certificate (verified by Ministry of Foreign Affairs Bangladesh)
  6. Notarized highest educational certificates and academic transcripts
  7. Bank solvency statement (where required for self-funded or partial awards)
